basis: a <header> slot over split geometry — the shell asserts no role of its own.

responsive.basis: the panel row is flex-wrap with min-width: 50% per panel, so panels stack in slot order with no media query (#158 is the doc-order case); every panel gutters step px-4 sm:px-6 3xl:px-8.

interaction.basis: two resizable panes around slotted content.

exceptions.because: no harness spec yet — keyboard resize between the panes is unproven in browser; the spec lands with the interaction-evidence tranche
